popCulture.title: Temple of Artemis
popCulture.description: Pindar and later tradition credit Otrera and the Amazons with founding the cult of Artemis at Ephesus — the shrine that became one of the Seven Wonders.

popCulture.title: Otrera
popCulture.description: First queen of the Amazons, consort of Ares, mother of Hippolyta and Penthesilea — founder of the Ephesian Artemis cult in Amazon lore.

popCulture.title: Penthesilea
popCulture.description: Otrera's daughter by Ares — the Amazon queen who fights Achilles at Troy and keeps her mother's name in the epic tradition.

popCulture.title: Amazons
popCulture.description: Otrera as founding mother of the Amazon nation — the queen who makes Thermodon and Ephesus part of the same warrior genealogy.
